# Adani Power Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Only the FY2024-25 Adani Power Integrated Annual Report (and its embedded FY2023-24 comparatives) was retrievable; dedicated FY2023-24 and FY2022-23 Annual Reports/CSR annexures and the MCA CSR-2 filing itself could not be located or fetched (direct adanipower.com PDF links for FY23/FY24 returned corrupted files, connect.adani.com equivalents 404'd, and the BSE-hosted BRSR filing was access-restricted). Search and document budget was exhausted pursuing these before falling back to the comparative chart/notes embedded in the FY2024-25 report.

Adani Power Limited (CIN L40100GJ1996PLC030533, registered Ahmedabad, Gujarat; website www.adanipower.com) is the Section 135-bound CSR filer; it implements CSR through Adani Foundation (implementing agency/partner, established 1996) and other Adani group entities (Adani Medicity and Research Center, Adani Institute For Education, Adani Skill Development Centre). Adani Foundation is recorded strictly as a partner/implementing agency here, not merged with Adani Power. Full statutory CSR annexure figures were obtained for FY2024-25 (average net profit ₹9,351.93 crore, 2% obligation ₹187.04 crore, amount spent ₹141.92 crore, unspent ₹36.43 crore transferred). For the three years actually requested (FY2023-24, FY2022-23, FY2021-22), only partial data could be recovered: a comparative chart in the FY2024-25 report gives the 2% CSR obligation as ₹57.67 crore for FY2023-24 and ₹14.73 crore for FY2022-23 (FY2021-22 not shown), and the same report states a prior-year (FY2023-24) contribution of ₹37.31 crore to Adani Foundation. Dedicated FY2023-24/FY2022-23 annual reports and the MCA CSR-2 filing itself could not be retrieved within budget (no PAN identifier or CSR-1 number found either). Rich footprint, programme and partner detail (Kawai, Tiroda, Godda, Udupi, Singrauli, Raipur, Raigarh, Mirzapur, Mundra, Korba, Tuticorin, Dahanu) and CSR theme spend was captured for FY2024-25, and no grants (as distinct from partner/implementing-agency contributions) or separately-stated priority geography were found.

Website: https://www.adanipower.com

## What it set out to find

- identity: legal name, funder_type, section_135_bound, website
- identifiers: CIN, domain, PAN
- csr_year FY2023-24, FY2022-23, FY2021-22: section_135_applicable, average_net_profit, prescribed_csr, spent_on_projects, admin_overheads, total_spent, unspent_transferred, impact_assessment_done
- csr_spend by project/aggregate with implementing agency Adani Foundation, sector, amount
- footprint: plant-adjacent districts (Mundra, Tiroda, Kawai, Udupi, Godda, Singrauli, Raipur, Raigarh, Mirzapur, Korba, Tuticorin, Dahanu) correctly paired with state
- stated_geography: priority states/regions distinct from footprint
- partners: Adani Foundation and other implementing agencies (Adani Medicity, Adani Institute for Education, Adani Skill Development Centre)
- programs/themes: Utthan, Udaan, Mobile Healthcare Units, Pashudhan Vikas, Adani Aarogya Card, Adani Saksham, SuPoshan
- metrics: beneficiaries, treatments, women/vulnerable beneficiaries
- contacts: CSR committee members
- documents: annual report / CSR annexure per year
